It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. from pathlib import Path
import json, struct
p=Path('/app/trunc.db'); b=p.read_bytes(); n=len(b)

def varint(buf, pos):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        x=buf[pos+i]
        if i==8: return (v<<8)|x, pos+9
        v=(v<<7)|(x&127)
        if not x&128: return v, pos+i+1
    raise ValueError('bad varint')

def serial(buf, pos, typ):
    if typ==0: return None,pos
    if typ==1: return int.from_bytes(buf[pos:pos+1],'big',signed=True),pos+1
    if typ==2: return int.from_bytes(buf[pos:pos+2],'big',signed=True),pos+2
    if typ==3: return int.from_bytes(buf[pos:pos+3],'big',signed=True),pos+3
    if typ==4: return int.from_bytes(buf[pos:pos+4],'big',signed=True),pos+4
    if typ==5: return int.from_bytes(buf[pos:pos+6],'big',signed=True),pos+6
    if typ==6: return int.from_bytes(buf[pos:pos+8],'big',signed=True),pos+8
    if typ==7: return struct.unpack('>d',buf[pos:pos+8])[0],pos+8
    if typ==8: return 0,pos
    if typ==9: return 1,pos
    if typ in (10,11): return None,pos
    if typ>=12:
        ln=(typ-12)//2
        raw=buf[pos:pos+ln]
        return (raw.decode('utf-8','replace') if typ%2 else raw),pos+ln
    raise ValueError(typ)

nc=int.from_bytes(b[3:5],'big')
ptrs=[int.from_bytes(b[8+2*i:10+2*i],'big') for i in range(nc)]
print('page type',hex(b[0]),'cells',nc,'pointers',ptrs)
rows=[]
for idx,off in enumerate(ptrs):
    start=off
    plen,q=varint(b,off); rowid,q=varint(b,q)
    hend,q2=varint(b,q); hstart=q; hendpos=q+hend
    types=[]; x=hendpos
    while x < hendpos: pass
    # header length includes its own varint; serial types begin at q2
    x=q2
    while x < q+hend:
        t,x=varint(b,x); types.append(t)
    data=x; vals=[]
    for t in types:
        v,data=serial(b,data,t); vals.append(v)
    print(idx,'offset',off,'payload',plen,'rowid',rowid,'types',types,'values',vals)
    rows.append(vals)

out=[]
for vals in rows:
    if len(vals)>=2:
        # expected schema is word text and value integer; tolerate reversed order
        if isinstance(vals[0],str) and isinstance(vals[1],int): word,value=vals[0],vals[1]
        elif isinstance(vals[1],str) and isinstance(vals[0],int): word,value=vals[1],vals[0]
        else: continue
        out.append({'word':word,'value':value})
Path('/app/recover.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
print('recovered',len(out),'rows')
print(Path('/app/recover.json').read_text(),end='')
PY

print('validated',len(x),'records')
